purpose: Reconstruct the source/archive timeline that can be established from Git objects and the supplied P2 audit ZIP.

reviewed_relationship.current_pipeline_changes: Path configuration, split validation, exact patient/case cardinality checks, discovery manifesting, provenance capture, professional wording, and CLI controls; the model definitions, transforms, loss call, optimizer, epoch budget, checkpoint criterion, evaluation metric, and benchmark calculation used for the reported table were not intentionally altered.
reviewed_relationship.current_core_changes: Documentation and class-name professionalization with backward-compatible aliases; parameter names, tensor shapes, and executed forward operations remain unchanged.

limitations: Git and ZIP timestamps establish a plausible temporal lineage, not proof of the command that produced the summary files.
The supplied archive omits original epoch logs, per-case rows, checkpoints, confirmed environment metadata, and the command transcript.
The ZIP timestamp has no encoded timezone and is not a cryptographic attestation.
This reconstructed record must not be used to mark strict evidence closure as complete.
audit_conclusion: Temporal/source lineage is partially reconstructed and consistent with the reported pipeline, but end-to-end historical run provenance remains incomplete.
